review_context: The independent reviewer blocked its earlier snapshot pending six resolutions; the final reviewer turn stopped at an account usage limit. This is a local resolution, not independent approval.

findings.title: Authoritative identity and control labels
findings.resolution: The protocol explicitly makes the current manifest normative and supersedes obsolete cache design wording, including the mixed_degree2 additive label. The exact additive and ridge games alone are zero-pair controls; mixed_degree2 is a nonadditive agreement control. Current resume/native-design provenance hashes are bound in the manifest.

findings.title: Deterministic RNG bytes
findings.resolution: The independent probe was rerun locally on the current manifest. Every exact seed/value/hash, all 256 pair seeds and permutations, all 15232 within-size seeds and their literal 128-by-119 matrix, and the complete within-size permutation hash match. Integer hex, little-endian digest bytes, private PCG64 streams, array dtypes and hash keys are explicit.

findings.title: Numerical comparison policy
findings.resolution: Protocol, manifest and reference implementation use the pre-native scale max(1,max(abs(v-v_empty))) and inclusive strict 1e-10+1e-12*scale, package FSII coordinate 1e-8+5e-9*scale and package FSII efficiency 1e-8+3e-8*scale bounds. Exact constraints mean float64 solver precision; above-order zeros remain exact. Full synthetic reference and mutation tests pass.

findings.title: Exact-suite order and call counts
findings.resolution: Eight fixed games, 45 random game/order instances and five separately counted full-order boundary instances are explicit: 58 exact instances and 174 index calls, plus 2992 empirical instances and 8976 calls. The separate n3/order3 boundary repeats its grid case intentionally. Finalization does not repeat empirical package calls.

findings.title: Prospective complete leaf and shard map
findings.resolution: The manifest enumerates 1075 non-reference tensor leaves and 660 expanded reference leaves. All paths are unique within their family and every shape product equals its declared element count. Ten physical donor shards, two clean_0 views and six logical split mappings are explicit. Synthetic harness tests validate physical seals, live shard byte/value rehashing, split views, tamper rejection and no concatenated donor copy.

findings.title: Executable geometry and aggregation rules
findings.resolution: Semantic tests verify feature-order squared-distance accumulation and smallest-source-ID exact ties, equal recipe-group weighting, descending stable pair ranking, retained complete random orders, zero-denominator flags and cardinality-preserving nulls. Actual native geometry and values remain unrun at this review.
